name: Commerce Payment Extra
description: Adds a capture/void automation layer on Drupal Commerce payments: a PaymentManager service that resolves an order's capturable/voidable payments (with override events), Advanced Queue job types that capture/void via the gateway plugin, and a commerce_payment_extra_order submodule that captures on order completion, voids on cancellation, and cron-auto-places fully-authorized abandoned draft orders.
project_description:
This module provides additional API to commerce_payment.

 Features included in this module:

- automatically place orders authorized on order balance

- capture payment if order state changes to completed

- cancel payment if order state changes to canceled
